Create a detailed production concept-art PARTS DESIGN SHEET expanding the supplied original AVATAR CONCEPT 01. Strict identity lock: the original black chin-length bob girl with rounded blue-violet eyes and gentle blush, graphite/ivory oversized hooded zip jacket, ivory high-neck top, black tailored SHORTS and opaque charcoal TIGHTS, chunky ankle sneakers. This is NOT concept 01B, 02 or 03. Preserve the original shapes, colors and motifs. Infer unseen construction conservatively. Landscape high-resolution sheet with big detailed drawings, minimal English labels and stable part IDs, no paragraphs, no watermark. This is a visual design breakdown, not a sewing pattern or manufacturing blueprint. Isolated wearable/component studies are clean synthetic illustration objects, not severed anatomy. Indicate hidden attachment areas with faint dashed lines. L and R always mean the CHARACTER'S anatomical left and right.
Sheet title '01 / HEAD - HAIR'.
Organize into 3 generous horizontal rows.
TOP: four large neck-up assembled head reference views, FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK, RIGHT SIDE, same scale and aligned. Include the exact original bangs, black bob, original small communication ear pieces and rectangular hair clip; keep head proportions and ears identical. Neck cutoff cleanly at base of neck.
MIDDLE: exploded HAIR-only assembly on a faint neutral head guide, front view and back view, with thin leader lines and IDs. Split into H01 crown/scalp cap; H02 central fringe; H03 fringe L; H04 fringe R; H05 temple side lock L; H06 temple side lock R; H07 outer bob shell L; H08 outer bob shell R; H09 rear bob shell; H10 fine nape layer. Show natural seam overlaps rather than separate floating arbitrary hair strands. The assembled look MUST remain the original smooth rounded black bob.
BOTTOM: orderly small isolated component gallery for H01-H10, each with OUTER and INNER views where relevant, rendered as curved hair meshes with root tabs and visible overlap margins. Under-fringe rear surfaces dark black, highlights only on outer surfaces. All fine component silhouettes visible and isolated with enough spacing. Hair clip and earpieces remain visible only in assembly overview; their detailed breakdown is on another sheet. Prioritize readable component shape and complete coverage of front/side/rear hair. Do not add ponytails or dye.
